title: Cypress fails to parse environment variables with commas

labels.name: pkg/server
labels.description: This is due to an issue in the packages/server directory

labels.name: stage: ready for work
labels.description: The issue is reproducible and in scope

labels.name: Triaged
labels.description: Issue has been routed to backlog.  This is not a commitment to have it prioritized by the team.

body:

### Desired behavior:

Cypress should be able to parse environment variables containing commas.

### Steps to reproduce: (app code and test code)

Run the following from a terminal:

`cypress open --env ABC="1,2,3"`

### Versions

Tested Cypress versions: 3.3.1, 3.2.0, 3.1.5
Operating system: Ubuntu 18.04.2 LTS
